website_metadata.notes: DBS Bank's GIFT City IFSC Banking Unit (inaugurated 2023-07-16) focuses on corporate banking: foreign-currency-denominated loans, External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) and trade finance. No IBU retail/term-deposit rate card published. dbs.bank.in publishes only domestic India FD rates, not IBU rates. Wholesale-only IBU.

warnings: Domestic dbs.bank.in FD rates exist but belong to the separate India entity, not this GIFT City IBU.
